name: Dire Fleet Daredevil
oracle_text:
First strike
When this creature enters, exile target instant or sorcery card from an opponent's graveyard. You may cast it this turn, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell. If that spell would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, exile target instant or sorcery card from an opponent's graveyard. You may cast it this turn, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell. If that spell would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead

needs.what: a flag on the `exile` / `grant_playable` play permission (e.g. `playable_exiles: true`) meaning "if a spell cast under this permission would be put into a graveyard, exile it instead" -- applied on resolution, on being countered and on fizzling, for the cast that used the permission
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `exile` takes `playable: this_turn`, `playable_cast_only` and `any_type`, which cover the first two clauses, but has no key for the graveyard-to-exile replacement. `cast_from_hand`/`cast_card` carry `exiles` (StackItem.exiles_instead) but cast immediately during resolution rather than granting a cast-this-turn permission. `grant_playable`'s `as_flashback` sets `obj.playable_exiles`, but that is only read in `_place_after_resolution`; the countered path (ops_stack) and fizzle path read only `StackItem.exiles_instead`, so a countered spell would land in the opponent's graveyard -- not exact, and a misuse of the flashback key
